basic_info.description: This exceptional 1,560 sq ft live/work loft in the historic Mullen Building combines urban sophistication with industrial elegance. Ideally situated in the heart of Mid-Market, this 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence is flooded with natural light through oversized windows and features soaring ceilings, polished concrete floors with radiant heat, and an expansive open-concept layout.    The chef's kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances, a 5-burner gas range, double oven, and a spacious walk-in pantryperfect for entertaining or day-to-day living. Both bedrooms include en-suite bathrooms, with the primary suite offering a custom walk-in closet. Enjoy cityscape views, including Sutro Tower, from your generous private deck.    Additional highlights include in-unit laundry, upgraded double-layer soundproofing, pre-wired WebPass high-speed internet, and a dedicated 1-car garage. With a Walk Score of 98, Transit Score of 100, and Bike Score of 99, this location is a commuter's dream.    Steps away from Oracle Park, Caltrain, and the UCSF Mission Bay campus, you're also surrounded by major employers like Salesforce, OpenAI, Amazon, Meta, Google, Atlassian, Cisco, Snap Inc., Uber, Pinterest, GitHub, Unity Technologies, and more.
